definitions.gloss: brush cutter; string trimmer; weed whacker
definitions.explanation: A handheld powered tool with a rotating blade or nylon cord on a long shaft, used to cut grass and undergrowth. It is the technical name found in manuals, safety rules, and rental listings.

examples.japanese: {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
{刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧メガネ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Wear safety goggles when using a brush cutter.

examples.japanese: {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧こと。
examples.english: It is dangerous if the brush cutter's blade hits a stone, so check the ground carefully.

notes:
{刈|か}り{払|はら}う (to cut down and clear away) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). Written {刈払機|かりはらいき} without okurigana in technical documents and product names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a brush cutter
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: the blade of a brush cutter
- {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取扱|とりあつか}い{講習|こうしゅう}: brush cutter handling course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草刈|くさか}り{機|き}→草刈り機：30228_kusakariki⟧: grass cutter — the everyday word for the same tool; {刈|か}り{払|はら}い{機|き} is the term used in manuals and safety regulations
- ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}→芝刈り機：17028_shibakariki⟧: lawn mower — a wheeled machine for lawns, not a handheld one
